The query is *"Give me the forecast for Lisbon."* The teacher answers `get_forecast(city="Lisbon", days=3)`.
At the token after `"days": `, here is what each model puts on the next token.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof target = Inputs.radio(["hard target (B)", "soft target (C)"], {value: "soft target (C)", label: "Train toward"})
probs = [
  {tok: "3", teacher: 0.584, student: 0.123},
  {tok: "7", teacher: 0.313, student: 0.805},
  {tok: "5", teacher: 0.090, student: 0.058},
  {tok: "anything else", teacher: 0.013, student: 0.014},
]
goal = probs.map(d => ({...d, goal: target.startsWith("hard") ? (d.tok === "3" ? 1 : 0) : d.teacher}))
loss = target.startsWith("hard")
  ? -Math.log(0.123)
  : d3.sum(goal, d => d.goal > 0 ? d.goal * Math.log(d.goal / d.student) : 0)
long = goal.flatMap(d => [
  {tok: d.tok, who: "trained toward", p: d.goal},
  {tok: d.tok, who: "the 0.8B now", p: d.student},
])
Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(width, 560), height: 240, style: {fontSize: "13px"}, marginLeft: 110,
  x: {label: "probability (%) →", domain: [0, 100], grid: true},
  y: {label: null, domain: probs.map(d => d.tok)},
  fy: {label: null, domain: ["trained toward", "the 0.8B now"], axis: null},
  color: {domain: ["trained toward", "the 0.8B now"], range: ["#2a78d6", "#c3c2b7"], legend: true},
  marks: [Plot.barX(long, {x: d => 100 * d.p, y: "tok", fy: "who", fill: "who", tip: true, title: d => `${d.who}: ${(100 * d.p).toFixed(1)}% on "${d.tok}"`})],
})
md`Loss at this token: **${loss.toFixed(2)} nats** (${target.startsWith("hard") ? "cross-entropy on the written token" : "KL(teacher ‖ student)"}).`
```
